cat > .tmp_recs.sql <<'EOF'
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE workspace.mlpab307b68.recs2ead15 AS
WITH ue AS (
  SELECT user_id,
    CAST(e1 AS DOUBLE) e1, CAST(e2 AS DOUBLE) e2, CAST(e3 AS DOUBLE) e3, CAST(e4 AS DOUBLE) e4,
    CAST(e5 AS DOUBLE) e5, CAST(e6 AS DOUBLE) e6, CAST(e7 AS DOUBLE) e7, CAST(e8 AS DOUBLE) e8
  FROM read_files('/Volumes/workspace/mlpab307b68/recsys_raw/user_embeddings.csv', format=>'csv', header=>true)
),
ie AS (
  SELECT item_id,
    CAST(e1 AS DOUBLE) e1, CAST(e2 AS DOUBLE) e2, CAST(e3 AS DOUBLE) e3, CAST(e4 AS DOUBLE) e4,
    CAST(e5 AS DOUBLE) e5, CAST(e6 AS DOUBLE) e6, CAST(e7 AS DOUBLE) e7, CAST(e8 AS DOUBLE) e8
  FROM read_files('/Volumes/workspace/mlpab307b68/recsys_raw/item_embeddings.csv', format=>'csv', header=>true)
),
inter AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_id, item_id
  FROM read_files('/Volumes/workspace/mlpab307b68/recsys_raw/interactions.csv', format=>'csv', header=>true)
),
scores AS (
  SELECT u.user_id, i.item_id,
    (u.e1*i.e1 + u.e2*i.e2 + u.e3*i.e3 + u.e4*i.e4 + u.e5*i.e5 + u.e6*i.e6 + u.e7*i.e7 + u.e8*i.e8) AS relevance
  FROM ue u CROSS JOIN ie i
  LEFT ANTI JOIN inter x ON x.user_id = u.user_id AND x.item_id = i.item_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT user_id, item_id,
    CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY relevance DESC, item_id ASC) AS INT) AS rank
  FROM scores
)
SELECT
  concat(user_id, '#', CAST(rank AS STRING)) AS rec_id,
  user_id,
  rank,
  item_id
FROM ranked
WHERE rank <= 5;
EOF
